query:
SELECT run_id, session_id AS "session_id!",
                (array_agg(bot_id) FILTER (WHERE bot_id IS NOT NULL))[1] AS bot_id
            FROM (
                SELECT run_id, session_id, bot_id
                FROM factory_step
                WHERE run_id = ANY($1)
                OFFSET 0
            ) steps
            WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY run_id, session_id
